name: Timnath
title: Artificial Turf in Timnath, CO — Metro District Homes | NoCo Turf Co.
description: Timnath went from 625 residents in 2010 to about 11,600, so a turf plan there usually starts with a subdivision's design rules, not the town code.
h1: Timnath's newest neighborhoods sit in seven named metro-district families
lede: Timnath is mostly new houses on new streets, and in a town that young the first stop for a turf plan is usually a subdivision's design rules, not the town code.

answer.question: Can I install artificial turf in my Timnath backyard?
answer.answer: Most likely, for a detached home. NoCo Turf Co. installs artificial turf in Timnath, Colorado, where 85.1% of homes date from 2010 or later, so subdivision design rules usually come first. Colorado law bars an HOA from prohibiting backyard turf on a detached home, though it can review the design. The town's current code couldn't be read, so ask Timnath Planning too.

blocks.h2: Timnath went from 625 residents in 2010 to about 11,600 in 2025.
paras: The 2010 Census counted 625 people in Timnath and the 2020 Census 6,487; the Census Bureau's 2025 estimate is about 11,600. The houses follow the same curve: 85.1% were built in 2010 or later.

The largest plats in the county's parcel map are Timnath Ranch at 557 acres, with plats recorded in 2026, Harmony at 555 acres and Timnath South at 483 acres, followed by Wildwing, Ladera and Serratoga Falls.

blocks.h2: The Town lists seven metro-district families, each with its own board.
paras: Timnath's metro-district page lists Serratoga Falls 1–3 (No. 3 is Kitchel Lake), South Timnath 1–2, Southwest Timnath 1–4, Timnath Lakes 1–6, Timnath Ranch 1–4, Trailside 1–5 and Wildwing 1–5.
Send the plan to your district or HOA for design review before any sod comes up.

blocks.h2: Harmony Club is a private Jim Engh course inside Timnath's second-largest plat.
paras: Harmony Club opened in 2007 and plays 7,464 yards; the Harmony plat around it covers 555 acres.

Colorado's 2025 amendment names putting and chipping greens as functional artificial turf, which the state's nonfunctional-turf ban does not reach; a town code can still be stricter, and Timnath's current code could not be read for this page. A backyard green on a Harmony lot is a private-yard project under your HOA's design rules.

blocks.h2: Timnath's treated water comes through the Soldier Canyon Filter Plant.
paras: ELCO, North Weld County Water District and Fort Collins-Loveland Water District jointly own the Soldier Canyon plant, which supplies Timnath. Fort Collins-Loveland, which serves parts of Timnath, charges most homes a $25.54 monthly base plus $2.99 per 1,000 gallons up to 5,000 in 2026, rising by tier to $6.83 above 50,000.

The district ran a voluntary Water Shortage Watch in 2026 and says its outdoor season has ended. Resource Central's lawn-replacement program, offered through the district, requires the replaced area to be at least half waterwise plants.

blocks.h2: Most of Timnath sits on low shrink-swell sandy loam, with a clay loam pocket.
paras: Soil surveys around central Timnath map mostly Paoli fine sandy loam and Table Mountain loam, both low shrink-swell, with a pocket of Loveland clay loam. The nearest NOAA station, Fort Collins 4E, averages 14.83 inches of precipitation, 48.4 inches of snow and 31.6 days at or above 90°F a year.
The largest hail NOAA logged near Timnath from 2011 through 2025 was 1.75 inches, on June 12, 2017 and July 29, 2018.

faq.q: Which Timnath metro district am I in?
faq.a: Check the Town's metro-district page. It lists seven families, each with its own board: Serratoga Falls 1–3 (No. 3 is Kitchel Lake), South Timnath 1–2, Southwest Timnath 1–4, Timnath Lakes 1–6, Timnath Ranch 1–4, Trailside 1–5 and Wildwing 1–5.

faq.q: Is there a rebate for turf in Timnath?
faq.a: No program found pays for it. Resource Central's lawn replacement, offered through Fort Collins-Loveland Water District, requires at least half waterwise plants.
